executive_summary.text: Eclipse BioMaterials (OPP-1003) is a renewal plus expansion at stage 5.0 Negotiate. Salesforce shows ACV 1879000, a 36-month term, 49% probability, a 2026-06-05 close date and high risk, and the account health is At risk.

The buyer group is split. Procurement says "We need a material reduction from the current run rate or a shorter commitment", while Security says "A reduction that removes restricted workflow support is not acceptable."

No discount position is approved. PN-4004 (18%, -8% uplift) is pending_deal_desk and PN-4005 (12%, -3% uplift) is pending_legal_and_manager. A second-hand report that Deal Desk verbally okayed a discount has not been checked.
Liability cap language is still open, and General Counsel has said no customer-facing concession language should go out until legal and Deal Desk approve it.
The internal package comparison must be final by 05-19 for the 05-21 board sponsor review. The audit export sample is complete, but research IT has not yet confirmed the exception owner.

The CDO sees a credible path this quarter: "My answer is yes, if approval gates are respected." Customer participants put medium confidence on the package path and close timing, and low confidence on the aggressive discount being approved.

negotiation_state.stage_assessment: Late-stage negotiation (5.0 Negotiate) that is waiting on approvals, not on a proposal. Discount, liability language and restricted data access requests are due for approval routing by 2026-05-14, and an internal comparison is due by 05-19 for the 05-21 board sponsor review.
negotiation_state.customer_position: Procurement wants a material cut from the run rate or a shorter term, and in writing still wants the aggressive option modelled. The CDO wants cost relief without a panic discount. Security rejects any concession that strips restricted workflow support. Legal wants precise terms and has not approved liability language.
negotiation_state.vendor_position: Two internal options: (1) keep the core renewal intact and add payment flexibility; (2) adjust packaging, for example deferring an analytics add-on, while keeping restricted workflow support. The larger discount is not approved and may be modelled only as a clearly labelled unapproved scenario.
